children: Chinese state-owned automaker Dongfeng Motor (0489.HK) said on Wednesday it would deepen its partnership with Huawei (HWT.UL) to develop next-generation intelligent vehicles and smart mobility solutions.

The announcement followed a meeting on Tuesday between Dongfeng executive Feng Changjun and Huawei founder Ren Zhengfei, along with other Huawei executives, at the technology congolomrate's headquarters in Shenzhen, Dongfeng said in a statement.
